refers.refers_to: Ravenscar Hall, the moorland estate with a library that the stranger seeks and is warned away from
Ravenscourt Hall, the hall Edmund Thorn calls home and where Lord Hartwell's guard bars passage
Ravensgar Hall, the hall Lord Edmund claims as his by right

groups.reason: All three refer to the same Hall: E01 warning at Ravenscar Hall [1-2] matches Edmund's homecoming/claim in E02-E03 [4-5], and E03 has the header Ravenscar Hall [3] beside dialogue naming Ravensgar Hall [5].
